Data policy: no fabricated proxies. FRED is the durable public backbone; if FRED_API_KEY is available, the official FRED API is used automatically. Derived charts such as year-over-year inflation or payroll change are computed directly from the cited FRED source series. 数据原则：不制造假proxy。FRED是稳定公开骨架；如果运行环境提供 FRED_API_KEY，脚本会自动使用FRED官方API。同比通胀、非农月度变化等派生图直接由标注的FRED原始序列计算。
